scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the active AquaHome countertop-dishwasher warranty video inspection while the weekend service slot is still tied to it.
Emerging Need: The inspection starts in the live room, then that same session stops on a serial-label mismatch and self-service uploads are disabled.
Decision Context: Observable notices show the room, hold, lock, and expiry; the saved warranty note contains the registered serial, receipt label, support route, and no-paid-plan limit needed to document the mismatch.
Consequence: Timely documentation can keep the inspection usable for weekend service; after expiry, the stalled room can no longer preserve that slot.

parameter.body: The countertop dishwasher warranty inspection room AH620 is active. Leak photos were received and the room is waiting on live serial-label validation before the weekend service slot can be confirmed.

parameter.content: I'm in the AquaHome video room now; it took the leak photos, but the serial-label step is spinning instead of moving to the service confirmation.

parameter.subject: Inspection room AH620 paused on serial mismatch
parameter.body: Room AH620 is paused because the serial-label scan does not match the registered warranty record. Self-service uploads and rescan are disabled for this same room. Warranty desk attachment remains possible until 10:25 today; after that, the room expires and the weekend service slot is released.

parameter.subject: Inspection room AH620 expired
parameter.body: Room AH620 expired without warranty desk attachment. The weekend service slot tied to this video inspection has been released; the claim may be reopened for a later inspection window.
